```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 18_regression_learning_checks
title: >
  Learning Checks
questions:
  - id: ss_residuals
    type: multiple-choice
    prompt: >
      "Sum of squared residuals" is most closely conceptually related to:
    options:
      - text: >
          Unexplained or error variability
        correct: true
      - text: >
          The slope of the line
      - text: >
          The intercept
      - text: >
          The sample size
    explanation: >
      Residuals are prediction errors, so their squared sum reflects leftover error
      variability.

  - id: ms_regression
    type: multiple-choice
    prompt: >
      "MS-regression" is most closely conceptually related to:
    options:
      - text: >
          Explained variability divided by its degrees of freedom
        correct: true
      - text: >
          A raw residual
      - text: >
          The mean of X
      - text: >
          A nominal scale
    explanation: >
      MS regression is the mean square for the variability accounted for by the
      regression model.

  - id: s_error
    type: multiple-choice
    prompt: >
      "s-error," the standard error of the estimate, is most closely conceptually
      related to:
    options:
      - text: >
          The standard deviation of points around the regression line
        correct: true
      - text: >
          The number of predictors only
      - text: >
          The y-intercept
      - text: >
          The total sample size with no variability
    explanation: >
      It quantifies how much observed Y values tend to vary around predicted Y
      values.

  - id: residuals
    type: multiple-choice
    prompt: >
      "Residuals" are most closely conceptually related to:
    options:
      - text: >
          Deviation scores from the regression line
        correct: true
      - text: >
          Treatment totals
      - text: >
          Critical values
      - text: >
          Random assignment
    explanation: >
      A residual is observed Y minus predicted Y, analogous to a deviation from a
      fitted line.
```
